interpretation: Headline reliability numbers are averaged over the retrieval-augmented systems (agentic, agentic_multivers, agentic_nopost, standard_rag); llm_only is excluded because it retrieves no evidence, so its judges/frameworks trivially agree on a single category. Pillar 3: pairwise Pearson r between three independent rule-based judges' continuous groundedness scores (primary) plus categorical observed agreement on their thresholded votes (secondary). Pillar 4: pairwise Pearson r between three independent rule-based scoring frameworks on the shared RAG-triad constructs. High values on both indicate the groundedness / faithfulness / relevance constructs are measured reliably (convergent validity), not as artefacts of one scoring rule.
